title: Copy of a cipher letter of Cardinal Alessandro Farnese (to Pier Luigi Farnese), intercepted, August 1547: a full page of figures, bare
correspondents: Cardinal Alessandro Farnese -> [Pier Luigi Farnese, duke of Parma and Piacenza] (copy made in Cosimo I's chancery)
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo del Principato 384, c. 78
folio_note: c. 78r headed "Copia / D'una littera del card.le Farnese", then about 35 lines of continuous figures, a few clear words at the foot. Inventory vol. III p. 103: "(Alessandro Farnese) a (Pier Luigi Farnese), s.l., s.d., c. 78", note "Copia di una lettera in cifra".
status: Bare (checked at 2000 px). Its neighbours are glossed: c. 70 (Valerio Amanio to Pier Luigi Farnese, Venice) has its decipherment at c. 71 ("Deciferato di M. Valerio"), and c. 76 (copy of a chapter of the French ambassador's letter, Rome 10 Aug 1547) has its decipherment at c. 79 (same heading); c. 78 has none (c. 80 is an unrelated letter).
why: An intercepted Farnese cipher of the weeks before Pier Luigi's murder (Sept 1547), unread; a Farnese family key of 1541-42 is already worked in this repo (targets/vatican5), and the glossed Amanio and French-ambassador copies in the same gathering show the chancery was reading Farnese traffic.
verify: Transcribe; test against the vatican5 Farnese key family; read cc. 70-71 and 76-79 to see which systems the chancery had broken.
source: ASF Mediceo del Principato, Carteggio universale (PAD images) + Carteggio universale di Cosimo I inventory PDFs (ASF Inventari on-line), second ASF Florence pass, Nov 2026
score_note: Scored from the images viewed during the second ASF Florence pass, 6 Nov 2026 (research/sweep_2026-11_asf_florence_2/)
access_note: scans public on ASF PAD (archividigitali), no login, curl works: unit page /archividigitali/unita-archivistica/?id=<ua> lists carte; each /archividigitali/riproduzione/?id=<id>&ua=<ua> names the ptif; IIIF /iipsrv/iipsrv.fcgi?IIIF=/data/iip-data/asfi/mdp_carteggio_universale/<filza>/<seq>_C_<carta>_<R|V>.ptif (2000 px). PAD holds filze 330-460 only (1537-1557).
prior_art: open as far as checked (6 Nov 2026): known.py finds nothing on the filza, the carta or the correspondent; the inventory notes no decipherment and none is written on or beside the page (neighbouring carte checked); ASF holds the chancery keys (Cifrari II serie, "Chiavi delle cifre del Carteggio di Cosimo I dal 1536 al 1573", 3 filze), not online; DECODE's ASFi "Governo Mediceo - cifre" volumes (R5687-R7459) are 17th-18th c.; Tomokiyo and Lasry not searched in this run.
vetting_note: needs Chrome: the Della Casa-Farnese Corrispondenza vol. II (1546-1547, ed. Comelli, Ledizioni 2022; air.unimi.it/retrieve/handle/2434/910303/1986673/Corrispondenza DellaCasa-Farnese-1546-1547-volume II intero.pdf, Cloudflare 403 to curl and WebFetch) must be checked for an August 1547 letter of Cardinal Farnese matching c. 78: the copy names no recipient (the inventory's Pier Luigi is bracketed) and the same filza holds intercepted Venice traffic (c. 70 Valerio Amanio from Venice). Done: c. 78r seen at 2000 px, about 35 lines of figures headed "Copia / D'una lettera del card.le Farnese" with a few clear words ("et darli Marco Fabritio", "publico, et consolatione"), bare; c. 79 is the decipherment of c. 76 (same heading, Rome 10 Aug 1547), not of c. 78; c. 80 unrelated; known.py on the filza, Alessandro and Pier Luigi Farnese: no duplicate (vatican5/farnese1541 are 1541-42 papal ciphers); Tomokiyo and GL.htm: nothing; two web searches found nothing on this copy.

title: Vilém z Rožmberka's ciphered correspondence with his supporters in Poland during his candidacy for the Polish throne
correspondents: Vilém z Rožmberka (Wilhelm von Rosenberg), Oberstburggraf of Bohemia <-> his partisans in Poland-Lithuania
shelfmark: SOA Třeboň, oddělení Třeboň, Historica Třeboň (NAD 124, II T 1), sign. 4834/36
folio_note: Signature as cited; extent not stated
status: Cited by L. Staněk, BA thesis, České Budějovice 2026 (theses.cz/id/hotwcc), note 657: "Srov. šifrovanou korespondenci jihočeského velmože a jeho tamějších stoupenců v SOA Třeboň, Historica Třeboň, sign. 4834/36", beside M. Slach, "Kandidatura Viléma z Rožmberka na polský trůn v l. 1573-1575", Jihočeský sborník historický 33 (1964), pp. 130-148. Neither the thesis nor DigiArchiv shows the item; the Historica Třeboň finding aids (nos. 87, 88, 498, 502, 505) are listed on DigiArchiv but their scans are not shown to an anonymous visitor. Whether Slach printed or deciphered the letters is not checked.
why: Sixteenth-century Bohemian magnate cipher for the 1573-75 Polish elections, outside the Habsburg chancery corpus; the repo notes (research/oldest) know of Rožmberk ciphers only in general.
verify: Read Slach 1964 for the letters and any decipherment; ask SOA Třeboň for scans of Historica Třeboň 4834/36 and check its finding aid (Historica Třeboň IV, 1571-1592) entry.
access_note: description only (a citation); scans to order from SOA Třeboň
